text:
maya: Sharing results from Asteria11b int8 bring-up on our rerank+QA slices. Overall cost and latency look great, but theres a recall/regression on the rerank head that worries product.
diego: Quick summary numbers pls.
maya: p50 gen latency down 24% (fp16 160ms -> int8 122ms), p95 similar, throughput +1.7x, cost/1M tokens down from $140 to $102. Rerank nDCG@10 on search-rewrite slice fell 0.037 absolute (from 0.662 -> 0.625), sample size 4k. QA F1 dropped 1.9 pts on the longform set.
sasha: Were these with kv-cache warm? any tail effects?
maya: Mixed runs, but warm-only runs show similar nDCG drop (~0.032). Tail latencies unchanged, small increase in p99 generator latency (~8%).
elaine: Do we have human labels or just offline metrics? product will ask about user-visible impact.
maya: Ran a 250-sample human spot-check focused on rerank failures: precision on top-3 down from 78% -> 70% (8pp absolute). Calls out more reordering of relevant docs.
diego: Could be quant noise in attention score logits causing rank shifts. Mitigations?
sasha: Options: 1) per-layer mixed precision (keep final MLP in fp16), 2) score-rescaling post-quant (temperature correction), 3) hybrid routing for rerank endpoints.
maya: I tested a simple temperature correction (multiply logits by 1.04) and regained ~60% of the nDCG loss in offline sim, latency cost negligible. Worth exploring.
elaine: Unit econ: if we hybrid-route rerank 25% to fp16 and 75% int8 whats the cost impact?
maya: Baseline for 150k daily queries avg 600 tokens: fp16 ~$12.6k/day, full-int8 ~$9.2k/day. 25% fp16 blend -> ~$10.7k/day (saves ~15% vs fp16). Expected weighted nDCG loss ~0.009 (small).
diego: For GTN guidance: recommend "rerank-safe defaults": temp-correction + 20-30% fp16 for high recall routes, canary first. Also include rollback triggers: nDCG drop > 0.015 or top-3 precision delta > 5pp.
sasha: I'll spin up a canary flag: asteria11b.rerank_hybrid = {int8:5%, fp16:95%} then gate to 25% after 24h if metrics stable. Add observability: paired A/B nDCG, top-k precision, hallucination rate for QA.
elaine: Product note: GTN should call out the user-visible example prompts where rank flips occurred and recommend additional human eval for any retrieval-heavy product.
canary-bot: Canary scheduled: asteria11b-rerank-hybrid canary will be created by sasha on 2026-04-12T10:00:00Z.
diego: Owners: maya -> run temp-correction grid + 1k samples; sasha -> create canary + alerts; elaine -> draft GTN blurb with playbook; me (diego) -> cost sims + significance.
maya: Quick eval command I used: ```bash
ri eval run --model asteria11b-int8 --suite rerank-search-qa --samples 4000 --kv-cache warm --out results/asteria_int8_rerank.json
```
sasha: Please drop results to drive and ping here. We'll start canary after grid completes.
maya: Uploaded results + human notes: https://drive.redwood/projects/asteria/asteria_int8_rerank_notes.md
diego: OK. Short term plan: try temp-correction + small hybrid gate. Long term: explore per-layer quant knobs for attention/MLP. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
